body.message:
As per your request, please find the 1-month rate for Seaside Hills Residences – 1 Bedroom Without View below:

October: AED 9,000

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is required.

The booking will be processed on a monthly basis only, with each month consisting of 30 nights.

For your reference, please find the property listing below:
https://www.bayut.com/property/details-15687525.html

*
Kindly note that the rate displayed on our website is applicable only for September. Rates may vary from month to month depending on availability and demand. Therefore, the above rate is applicable to your requested period.
*

*
Long-Stay Booking Terms:
*
To secure a 3-month or 6-month booking, the first month’s rent, last month’s rent, and security deposit must be paid in advance. Once payment is received, we can reserve the unit and secure the agreed rate for the confirmed booking period.

Thank you, and please let us know if you would like to proceed.
